scope: Selected designated public RGB hashes, public robot numeric metrics, final operational decisions and applied boundaries only. Official outcome is reported separately in the review; no evaluator geometry, seed, contact labels, raw reasoning, credentials or private runtime.
residual_convention: target minus measured; targetfinger is intent not contactproof; fingertip-origin distance is not contactgap.

decision.reason: Robot 0 now clearly sees the target fingertips above and outside the right end of the rim; robot 1 maintains the opposite support. Shift the opening about 5.5 cm right beneath the hand with a 1.4 cm rise, then inspect whether the fingertips approach or cross the rim.
